data.description:
# Task C4: Discovery plugin + launcher presets resolve `src/` sibling layouts

Parent: F9 CG-0MUH0NTRG007GDME (part of epic CG-0MTR7DLMY008CK17).
Depends on: C1 (scenePath contract).

## Goal

As a distribution builder the launcher resolves a game's scene whether the game is in the flat monorepo (`example-games/<game>/…`) or in a `src/`-layout sibling repo (`../tce-<game>/src/…`), so `npm run build` works for the `solo` (1 game) and `full` (all games) presets after the layout change.

## Scope

1. Implement the C1 `scenePath` contract in `scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts` (`discoverGames`, local vs sibling resolution) and `configs/*.json` presets (`full`, `solo`, `arcade`, `deluxe`, `core-only`).
2. Keep `core-only` (Gym, no games) working.
3. Game repos keep their own `configs/game.json` valid for the `src/` local layout (coordinate with C3).
4. Update the plugin unit tests (`tests/scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.test.ts`) with a `src/`-layout sibling fixture and an error case for a missing scene.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Plugin resolves both flat-monorepo and `src/` sibling layouts; unit tests green.
2. `GAMES_CONFIG=configs/solo.json npm run build` and `GAMES_CONFIG=configs/full.json npm run build` succeed in the launcher against composed siblings; the selector enumerates exactly the configured games.
3. `GAMES_CONFIG=configs/core-only.json npm run build` still succeeds (Gym only).
4. Fail-fast, actionable error when a configured sibling scene is absent.

## Key Files

- `scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts`
- `configs/*.json`
- `tests/scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.test.ts`

data.author: herdr
data.comment:
C4 implemented.

- `scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts`: `GameConfigEntry` gains `siblingScenePath` / `siblingAdapterPath`; `discoverGames` now resolves a scene by trying, in order, the flat monorepo path (`projectRoot/<scenePath>`), the explicit `src/`-layout sibling path (`<path>/<siblingScenePath>`), then the legacy sibling path (`<path>/<scenePath>`). The not-found error now lists every candidate path.
- `scripts/adapters/index.ts`: `registerConfiguredAdapters` resolves the replay adapter through the same candidate order (`adapterPath`, `<path>/<siblingAdapterPath>`, `<path>/<adapterPath>`), so the replay CLI works against a `src/` sibling repo too.
- `configs/{full,solo,arcade,deluxe}.json`: every game entry now records `siblingScenePath` (`src/scenes/<Game>Scene.ts`) and, where present, `siblingAdapterPath` (`src/scripts/adapters/<Game>ReplayAdapter.ts`); `$comment` documents the two-layout contract. `core-only.json` unchanged (no games).
- `tests/scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.test.ts`: new `src/`-layout sibling fixture + tests (resolve via `siblingScenePath`; fail-fast error lists the `src/` candidate); preset tests assert `siblingScenePath`/`siblingAdapterPath` are derived from the monorepo paths.
- AC evidence: `GAMES_CONFIG=configs/core-only.json npm run build` (283 modules), `.../solo.json` (303 modules, Golf only) and `.../full.json` (480 modules, all 8 games) all exit 0 in the launcher; `npm run build` (default core-only) green; terminology guard PASS; `npm test -- --project unit` green (414 files / 7140 tests).
